parameters.query:
INSERT INTO orders (shopify_order_id, order_number, customer_name, customer_phone, customer_email, items, total_price, status, created_at)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.shopify_order_id }}',
  '{{ $json.order_number }}',
  '{{ $json.customer_name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.customer_phone }}',
  '{{ $json.customer_email }}',
  '{{ $json.items.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.total_price }}',
  'pending_confirmation',
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (shopify_order_id) DO NOTHING;
